races.name: Bar 1 Betting Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
KILLEEMORE LAD has made a promising start over fences and could prove hard to catch around here if he's again ridden prominently. Tell Us This won a big-field Galway handicap chase a fortnight ago but his jumping remains a concern, while the quirky Luker's Tipple wouldn't be the safest conveyance despite going for a hat-trick on his chasing debut.

  1. KILLEEMORE LAD (IRE)
  2. TELL US THIS (IRE)
  3. LUKER'S TIPPLE (IRE)

races.name: O'Neill's Bar Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
JUKE HILL went with promise on his chase debut at Wexford and can score with the longer trip likely to suit. Burru has to bounce back from a disappointing effort over hurdles but showed aptitude for chasing last summer and his free-going style will suit Tramore, whilst 4-y-o Kasper Hauser is an interesting chase newcomer given his weight allowance.

  1. JUKE HILL (IRE)
  2. BURRU (IRE)
  3. KASPER HAUSER

races.name: McDonald & Son Builders Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
SPANISH RISING matched his fair form on the Flat at the first attempt over hurdles when making the frame at Ballinrobe last month and, with this slightly shorter trip promising to suit, he is taken to open his account. Rosarian is feared most after her much-improved second at Kilbeggan on return, ahead of Johnny Rambo.

  1. SPANISH RISING (IRE)
  2. ROSARIAN (IRE)
  3. JOHNNY RAMBO (IRE)

races.name: Flynn Hotel Group Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHURCHWARDEN opened his account on the Flat here the previous month and is potentially well treated on the pick of last season's form now returning to hurdling, so he gets the nod to follow up. Rightfolksplease has been thriving since returning to action for a new yard and can give another good account back over the smaller obstacles, while the in-form Dairy Force is also well respected now back in a less competitive affair.

  1. CHURCHWARDEN (IRE)
  2. RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE (IRE)
  3. DAIRY FORCE (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
MR MASTER MAC produced a much improved effort when second in a big-field handicap at Galway 11 days ago and looks the one to beat, provided he copes with the drop back in trip and quick turnaround. Lureka Du Noyer and Early Dawning are feared most.

  1. MR MASTER MAC (IRE)
  2. LUREKA DU NOYER (FR)
  3. EARLY DAWNING (TUR)

races.name: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
PRINCESS FELICIA may make her second start for David Harry Kelly a winning one. Maxicourt and Diamond Secret are other likely types, while Arctic Piper and Taketwotoone both make each-way appeal.

  1. PRINCESS FELICIA (IRE)
  2. MAXICOURT (IRE)
  3. DIAMOND SECRET (FR)

races.name: Conor Lannen Country Store (Ladies) Maiden
races.verdict:
DREAM ON BABY is yet to finish outside the placings in her 4 Flat starts and partnered by a jockey who has enjoyed plenty of success in this race in recent seasons, Emmet Mullins' 6-y-o earns the vote. Splashing Out has been in good heart over hurdles this summer so she looks an interesting runner switched to this sphere, with Kimy and Blue Nasturtium another couple worth considering, too.

  1. DREAM ON BABY (IRE)
  2. SPLASHING OUT (IRE)
  3. KIMY (FR)

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
The step back up in trip may see SYDNEY ROCK open her account. Decalogue is going the right way and needs considering along with Kimeko Glory (first-time headgear) in an ordinary contest.

  1. SYDNEY ROCK
  2. DECALOGUE (USA)
  3. KIMEKO GLORY

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A potential match between FLOODING and Tiora Time, with preference for the former having looked to be getting the hang of things late when runner-up on debut at Newmarket last month. With Oisin Murphy taking over, she can get the better of Tom Clover's filly, who opened her account at Doncaster earlier in the month and looks capable of better again. All Angels debut wasn't devoid of promise so she can fill out third.

  1. FLOODING (IRE)
  2. TIORA TIME
  3. ALL ANGELS

races.name: Colin Hinton & Mitch Hinton Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SERENETTA has likely been found a good opportunity to follow up last December's Kempton win.

  1. SERENETTA
  2. REFORMATION

races.name: Tattersalls 40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A low turnout for a very valuable novice, with SIENA STORM selected to build on her encouraging debut fourth at Goodwood a fortnight ago with this step up in trip sure to be in her favour. Heading up the dangers is Clarity, who finished a place behind the selection last time and should find that outing aiding her development further. Indian Lights looks best of the remainder.

  1. SIENA STORM (GER)
  2. CLARITY (IRE)
  3. INDIAN LIGHTS (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A relatively valuable handicap in which 3-y-os have an excellent record. The vote goes to RUBY WEDDING, who was only bettered by a well-backed improver at Newcastle last time. Hat-trick seeking Counter Intuitive is feared most, while there could be more to come from the in-form Ollie Sangster pair.

  1. RUBY WEDDING
  2. COUNTER INTUITIVE (IRE)
  3. ROSSA RAHEEN

races.name: Venture Security Handicap
races.verdict:
It's hard to believe we've seen the best of SEVEN SISTERS given her pedigree/connections. She's fancied to resume winning ways on return to a more conventional track, while Supplicate arrives on a roll and stands out as the main danger.

  1. SEVEN SISTERS
  2. SUPPLICATE
  3. AKHO MEZZNA (FR)

races.name: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Handicap
races.verdict:
SOLAR INVINCIBLE has found one too good here on his last 2 outings but the form of those efforts read well and with the benefit of a better draw and swing at the weights, he can turn the tables on Madman, who beat him here 17 days ago. Pilgrim's Progress completes the shortlist after a good effort in maiden company here last time.

  1. SOLAR INVINCIBLE (IRE)
  2. MADMAN
  3. PILGRIM'S PROGRESS

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
METHGAL was very well backed when runner-up on his recent yard debut and with his usual blinkers quickly reapplied, Dylan Cunha's charge earns the vote to double his career tally. Beelzebub has made a positive start for new connections, so he could be the one to give the selection most to think about, with Beach Partee and Legendsoftheland another couple fancied to be in the mix, too.

  1. METHGAL (IRE)
  2. BEELZEBUB (IRE)
  3. BEACH PARTEE

races.name: Matchbook Loves Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy event in which TOO HOT TO TANGO is given another chance to build on June's C&D win. Stable switcher Knights Gold is also considered, with the consistent Signcastle City likely to give another good account.

  1. TOO HOT TO TANGO
  2. KNIGHTS GOLD (IRE)
  3. SIGNCASTLE CITY (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WATERFORD CASTLE deserves to get off the mark, and his experience may see him edge out highly-touted newcomer Partying.

  1. WATERFORD CASTLE (IRE)
  2. PARTYING
  3. THATCHAM

races.name: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A MAJOR PAYNE is thriving at present and can notch his third win from his last 4 starts. Law Court and City of Poets, both of whom are stepping up in trip after finishing mid-field in competitive handicaps at Glorious Goodwood, are also respected back in these calmer waters.

  1. A MAJOR PAYNE
  2. LAW COURT (IRE)
  3. CITY OF POETS (IRE)

races.name: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
races.verdict:
Not much to split recent course winners IMPOSSIBLE MISSION and Mythological Star, the former narrowly preferred given this could be tactical.

  1. IMPOSSIBLE MISSION
  2. MYTHOLOGICAL STAR (IRE)
  3. ROKER ROAR (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WHAT A GIRL WANTS sets the standard on her Irish form and this drop in grade could be just what she needs to get off the mark. Not My Type has to concede a penalty after her winning debut but she's open to plenty of progress, with Empress Princess perhaps the pick of the newcomers.

  1. WHAT A GIRL WANTS (IRE)
  2. NOT MY TYPE
  3. EMPRESS PRINCESS (IRE)

races.name: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery
races.verdict:
CONCERT PITCH took a step forward when worn down only late by his market rival at Carlisle on Tuesday and he could be ready to go one better if turned out again quickly. Enemy Action has made the frame on his last 2 starts and is respected, while six-figure breeze-up purchase Targa also makes appeal.

  1. CONCERT PITCH (IRE)
  2. ENEMY ACTION (IRE)
  3. TARGA (IRE)

races.name: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery
races.verdict:
ARIANE SKY was much improved when making a winning nursery debut at Ffos Las 16 days ago and a 3 lb rise may well be within range from a handy draw. State Of Gold and Sovereign Beach are feared most on their first try over 7f.

  1. ARIANE SKY (IRE)
  2. STATE OF GOLD (IRE)
  3. SOVEREIGN BEACH (IRE)

races.name: Connexin Super Fast Sprint Handicap
races.verdict:
Paul Midgley is responsible for a couple of class droppers in AMERICAN BAY and Ventura Express. Both are well drawn to attack with the former marginally preferred as he arrives in better order. Shazani and Ingleby Archie drop back in trip but are not short of pace and also enter calculations.

  1. AMERICAN BAY
  2. VENTURA EXPRESS
  3. SHAZANI (FR)

races.name: Middle Distance Handicap
races.verdict:
MR MOONSHINE has benefited from going up in distance on his last 2 starts, only narrowly denied by a pair of fellow 3-y-os at Chester on his latest outing, and he can build on those efforts to get off the mark. Grey Fable finished a place behind the selection 19 days ago and could be the biggest threat, ahead of That Darn Cantor.

  1. MR MOONSHINE (IRE)
  2. GREY FABLE (IRE)
  3. THAT DARN CANTOR

races.name: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
races.verdict:
SAXON GRACE impressed with how she travelled through the race when scoring at Redcar last week and, with more still to offer at around this trip, she is taken to follow-up under a penalty. The 3-y-o can see off the challenge of Dumfries, who has dropped back down to his last winning mark, with Ten Sixty Six also considered.

  1. SAXON GRACE (IRE)
  2. DUMFRIES
  3. TEN SIXTY SIX (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
EAGLES ATTIRE looks to have been brought along with handicaps in mind and can improve markedly for this step up in trip so he's well worth taking a chance on. Both Barbury Boy and Alice de Clare are other 3-y-os to consider, while the John Butler-trained pair, Kaaranah and Jack Sparowe, also merit respect given the stable's excellent form.

  1. EAGLES ATTIRE (IRE)
  2. BARBURY BOY
  3. ALICE DE CLARE (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HUWA BAREE is well bred and in the right hands to make a winning start in what looks a weak affair. Aljoon has shown much the best form to date so could capitalise if greenness catches out the selection, while Mr Badger is another newcomer to consider.

  1. HUWA BAREE (USA)
  2. ALJOON (IRE)
  3. MR BADGER

races.name: Emilies 21st Birthday Handicap
races.verdict:
CAPTIVE BEAUTY is less exposed than most of these and shaped well when a close second last time so another step forward could be enough for her to edge out the experienced Split Elevens. Oxford Circus merits a check in the betting given the stable he's joined.

  1. CAPTIVE BEAUTY (IRE)
  2. SPLIT ELEVENS
  3. OXFORD CIRCUS (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
ZALTALLA has shown promise since joining this yard, looking unlucky when meeting trouble last time, and if handling the drop to 6f, he could prove the answer. Pure Passion is unexposed and looks sure to be a threat, while Real Gold has reasons that could see her bounce back to form, chiefly the return to this surface.

  1. ZALTALLA (FR)
  2. PURE PASSION
  3. REAL GOLD

races.name: Become A Friend Of Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SHANGRI LA looks the percentage call in a winnable maiden, while there ought to be better come from Dove Tale and Neswick.

  1. SHANGRI LA
  2. DOVE TALE (GER)
  3. NESWICK

races.name: Download The At The Races App Nursery
races.verdict:
SOUTH WEST, whose Catterick win last month has been boosted could be the answer from a very fair opening mark. Nursery debutants Viking Barbie and Sultan Darius could also improve in what looks an interesting race for the grade.

  1. SOUTH WEST (IRE)
  2. VIKING BARBIE (IRE)
  3. STONEY WOOD (IRE)
